scope: Session-injected history routing, lightweight transition labels, existing owner cancellation coordination, retired forwarding methods, native/public-session regressions and contribution documentation. No document storage, format, renderer or dependency change.

native_environment.surface: Production Main.qml and existing SubnetParameters.qml loaded by the application input harness; native Qt key/menu/pointer input. Final captures use the native scene-graph renderer. The earlier software-renderer tool capture was black and is excluded.

authority.prototype: docs/evidence/issue25-coverage-v1.json and archived handlers in assets/issue25-prototype-reference-v1.tar.gz; exact coverage mapping is in the pre-edit contract. #86 is new history-access authority, not invented prototype parity.

acceptance.scenario: Graph without media or viewer target
acceptance.result: Native creation, movement, connection, reroute, endpoint replacement, disconnect and deletion restore authored graph state through shared keys/menu; connection/reroute redo restores the same records.
Native collapse is one chronological step; undo unwinds the removed entered occurrence to its surviving graph. Existing scoped/atomic coverage supplies unchanged variants.
Graph, parameter and media edits follow document chronology across Graph/Media focus; animation insertion uses that same committed history.

acceptance.scenario: Text editing and exhausted local history
acceptance.result: Real search/numeric text handles local key/menu undo and redo, including exhaustion, without document fallback or premature numeric commit. Explicit Return still commits.

acceptance.scenario: Active graph, parameter and key gestures
acceptance.result: Undo cancels previews only; Redo cannot publish; resumed motion/release cannot commit. Prior authored content and revisions remain unchanged. Numeric and slider visible previews stay reverted during resumed motion; a fresh slider press still commits and undoes normally.

acceptance.scenario: Main and existing tool window lifetime
acceptance.result: Three tool reopen cycles target the same session; one input produces one transition. An unrelated active QQuickWindow cannot dispatch history.
Empty shared actions disable; rejected editing leaves state/history intact; existing feedback is retained; a new edit after undo clears the old redo branch.

Public label queries follow transactions, undo/redo, eviction and branch replacement. Labels are runtime-only. Opposite-ring transfers move both label and touched recorder after fallible preparation; Entry move is statically required to be noexcept.
Existing snapshot isolation, stable restored identities and monotonic freshness contracts remain intact. Native comparisons intentionally do not expect ID allocation watermarks to roll backward.

A native parameter edit becomes dirty, undo to saved authored content becomes clean, redo becomes dirty; replacement clears availability/history. Existing persistence coverage protects save/open lifecycle. Structural ID allocation and presentation changes are not incorrectly treated as undoable saved-state changes.

acceptance.scenario: Adjacent selection, navigation, view and layout
acceptance.result: Accepted view/panel routing and normal edit commit/cancel behavior remain with their owners. Navigation/selection are not registered as authored previews or document history.
Native Ctrl+Z restores the 96x64 Read presentation after a 40x20 replacement; Ctrl+Shift+Z restores 40x20. Existing request/revision stale-result protection is unchanged.

Existing #69/#72 driver seed with 1024 chain nodes: native edit, focus, undo/redo and clean/dirty transitions completed. Whole fixture took 11.078 seconds including load/setup/save/teardown; no per-edit latency measurement or claim of stall-free interaction. The seed retains its pre-existing overlapping layout.
acceptance.reproduction: Compile docs/evidence/assets/issue69-editing-scale/editing_scale_driver.cpp using the existing #72 recipe; run editing_scale_driver seed /tmp/nemo86-large.nemo 1024. No new builder, benchmark or threshold.

visual_review.result: Retained native captures inspected by the implementation agent; shared menus reuse shell controls/theme and existing tool header. Graph geometry, A–E chrome and inspector/animation owners are not redesigned.
visual_review.remaining_gate: Owner native appearance/interaction and minimal internal-interface acceptance remain separate. No prior #72/#75/#83–85 gate is closed; Windows remains on roadmap hold.

diagnosis.regression: The initial native numeric menu test showed focus leaving the buffer before menu activation, committing text. Qt 6.4 QQuickMenuPrivate::onItemHovered forces item focus even when focusPolicy is NoFocus. Shared HistoryMenuItem disables the native hover-focus path and uses a focus-preserving pointer area; repeated text menu undo/redo now preserves the buffer.
diagnosis.slider_regression: Native held-slider Redo initially published because Qt 6.4 ends Slider.pressed on unrelated key release. Resumed pointer motion also rewrote value before moved. The existing Slider now ignores non-editing key releases while pressed and restores authored value for a cancelled press. The red regression passes, including a fresh subsequent press that commits normally and undoes correctly.

limitations: No hosted CI or Windows run was requested.
Native event/capture evidence is not human appearance approval or a per-action latency benchmark.
User-modified issue34 workflow/autosave/backup assets are excluded from the commit.
Archived #43 scenario-final-catalog-v8.json still references retired mediaLibrary.canUndo. Historical evidence is intentionally unchanged and is not a current replay script.
capture_notes: Client-surface captures; native window-title clean/dirty transitions are asserted by the input scenario, not pictured in client-only screenshots. The large workload capture used the native Wayland software scene-graph path; final small/tool/viewer captures use the native renderer.

review.standards: No unresolved hard violations. Replaced internal gesture/token test assertions with visible geometry/text/handle assertions. Explicit public-interface declarations are required in the commit/task. Small routing switches, capture state and owner registration remain deliberately narrow instead of introducing a generic framework.
review.spec: No unresolved violations after slider evidence gap exposed and fixed the held-key-release/resumed-motion bugs. Independent reviewer checked the correction against the recorded issue scope.
review.owner_observation: New history menus preserve text focus and are pointer-operated; standard Qt history shortcuts remain keyboard access. Keyboard menu navigation and final appearance/interaction remain with owner review.
